## Specific task description

Task instruction: Press down on the black stapler firmly using the right arm.

Task description: The target is the black stapler lying at an angle at the front right of the table. Use the right arm to press it down.

Success criteria: The right end effector makes actual contact near the designated press location on the black stapler and presses downward; both the horizontal position and height of contact must be close to that location.

## Execution tips

- Consider partially closing the right gripper and using its tips to contact a flat area of the top cover with sufficient contact width. Avoid placing the spread fingers on either side of the stapler and missing the press surface.
- Avoid the lid's side edges and rounded ends; approach from above, nearly vertically, to reduce fingertip edge contact or slipping along a slope.
- After contact, press down gradually in small increments and observe the actual contact point. If the fingertip is offset to the side, ease the contact before adjusting to avoid scraping sideways under pressure.
